line: “Livin’ my best Life” Bitch, Carpe Diem
meaning:
“Living my Best Life” is a song released in 2018 by Lil Duval featuring Snoop Dogg.
Carpe diem means to make most out of the moment and what you have now and not worry about the future.
Jae is stating that he is living his best life and not worried about the past mistakes and what will happen in the future. He is living in the moment.

meaning:
“Whiteys” are a nick name for xanax.
Slump man means that someone is passed out.
Jae is indicating that you’ll swallow too many xanax pills an be passed out of the drugs intoxication.

line: “White Men Can’t Jump” Well bitch I rock that Jump Man
meaning:
“White Men Can’t Jump” was a 90’s movie starring Wesley Snipes and Woody Harrelson about two con men who team up together to make some money on the basketball courts of Los Angeles.
“Jump Man” is a nick name for Michael Jordan’s shoe logo.
Jae is stating that he will wear Jordan shoes even if he can’t jump.

line: Evel Knievel Bitch I just stunt-man.
meaning:
Evel Knievel was a stunt man who was most known for his death-defying stunts jumping from ramp to ramp on a motorcycle.
Jae is stating that his outfits also stunt on everybody’s and nobody dresses like him.

line: If you smokin’ “Reggie Bush” Bitch, run-it-back
meaning:
Reggie Bush was a professional football player in the NFL who played a total of 12 seasons. He was a running back for the New Orleans Saints, Buffalo Bills, Miami Dolphins, Detroit Lions, and the San Francisco 49ers.
“Reggie Bush” is also a term for some regular weed. Meaning that this artist doesn’t smoke regular weed, only the best there is.
